metadata.title: SAR - DMARC Not Enforced on Campaign Domains
metadata.remarks: Assessment result identifying campaign email domains publishing DMARC without an enforcing policy, contrary to the DNS Secure Email SSPP.

findings.title: DMARC Not Enforced on Campaign Domain
findings.description: One or more campaign email domains publish DMARC with a non-enforcing policy (e.g., p=none), which does not meet institutional DNS Secure Email requirements.

associated-risk.title: Campaign Email Spoofing and Abuse
associated-risk.description: Non-enforcing DMARC on campaign domains allows unauthorized senders to spoof campaign messages, increasing phishing and reputational risk.

remediations.title: Enforce DMARC on Campaign Domain
remediations.description: Update DMARC policy for campaign domains to an enforcing posture in accordance with the DNS Secure Email SSPP.

tasks.title: Update DMARC Policy to Enforcing Mode
tasks.description: Modify the DMARC record for campaign domains to enforce rejection or quarantine and validate alignment with SPF and DKIM.
